Trusted Local Experience

About Puri Transport

Reliable pick-up, drop-off, and private tours throughout Kuta Lombok and the entire island.

Our Story

We are one of the most experienced transport and tour service providers in Lombok, especially in Kuta Lombok and its surroundings. We were established even before Kuta Lombok grew into the world-class destination it is today.

The comfort, punctuality, and safety of our guests are the core values that have kept us trusted by travelers from around the world.

Talk to Our Team

Local Guides & Drivers

Experienced local drivers with good English who know the best scenic routes, not just the crowded spots.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you offer private tours and private taxi transfers?

Yes, all of our tours and taxi services are 100% private for you and your group.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept cash (IDR) or bank transfer.

Are entrance tickets or boat tickets included?

No, attraction entrance tickets and boat tickets are not included unless specified in your booking.

Is there a group discount?

Yes. Group tours receive a 10% discount per person.

What if the weather is bad?

If weather conditions are unsafe, we will notify you before departure so we can adjust or reschedule your trip.

Can I reschedule or cancel?

Please contact us as early as possible for schedule changes. If cancelled, the 20% deposit is non-refundable.
